title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), any PEM user can read the encrypted passwords that PEM agents use to connect to…
description: Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) versions prior to 10.6.1 store encrypted passwords for PEM agents and the PEM backend superuser using a default encryption key common to all installations. This allows any PEM user to decrypt and read these passwords. Starting with PEM 10.6.1, this issue is resolved by preventing PEM users from reading these passwords.
